counterparty.name: NVIDIA Corporation
counterparty.description: AI compute leader. Chose Unitree as hardware partner for the Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot (GTC Taipei 2026-05-31): Unitree H2 Plus body + Jetson AGX Thor; GR00T platform also supports Unitree G1.

relationship.summary: NVIDIA selected Unitree as the hardware foundation of its first open humanoid reference design (Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot, announced GTC Taipei 2026-05-31): Unitree H2 Plus chassis + Jetson AGX Thor compute, sold via Unitree in late 2026; the GR00T developer platform also supports the Unitree G1.

candidates.title: NVIDIA Announces NVIDIA Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot for Academic Research
candidates.publisher: NVIDIA Corporation official press release (syndicated via ADVFN)

candidates.title: Nvidia Taps Chinese Company Unitree for First Humanoid Robot System Sold to Researchers
candidates.quote: The company announced Monday that its Isaac GR00T humanoid robot developer platform will support Unitree's G1 humanoid robot and a new reference design using Unitree hardware, Nvidia computing, and mechanical hands from Singapore-based Sharpa.
